core_obligations: Give T the reduced induced subspace structure Z -> X (proof lines 5144-5146).
Show that Z -> X is locally of finite type and hence that finite type points of Z are finite type points of X inside T (proof lines 5147-5151).
Use that a nonempty affine scheme mapping etale to Z has a closed point to produce a finite type point of Z (proof lines 5152-5155).
Conclude both the implication and the density statement (proof lines 5140-5141 and 5155-5156).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space X over a scheme S, every nonempty locally closed subset T of |X| meets the set of finite type points, and consequently for closed T the finite type points of T are dense in T (source lines 5131-5142). The proof puts the reduced induced subspace structure on T, notes that the immersion Z -> X is locally of finite type so that the finite type points of Z are finite type points of X lying in T, and concludes because a nonempty affine scheme mapping etale to Z has a closed point, hence Z has a finite type point.
